short.q: Describe how a clarinet produces sound.
short.model: Air blown across a single reed makes it vibrate, and keys change the pitch.

short.q: Why can't a harpsichord change dynamics by touch?
short.model: Its strings are plucked mechanically, so the volume stays the same however hard the key is pressed.
